tmpRow.title: Mundane Skills
tmpRow.titleText:
Gain experience in these professions without affecting your status. Gain the knowledge of working in these professions for around 5 years under the guidance of a teacher that would be considered proficient anywhere in the world. Gain no skills or skill levels from this knowledge, but the experience should allow you to quickly earn those levels yourself. Expect that any choice made here will be enough accomplishments in that field to earn a profession related to it, though with no further work it would be at the lowest level. These should provide a strong starting point to delve into magical evolutions of these professions.

Receive 1 selection for free.

addons.text:
This cyoa is based on the book series Elydes by Drew Wells, which you can find more info on here: https://www.royalroad.com/fiction/67742/elydes

I tried to write it so that you wouldn't need to have read the books, but I personally really enjoy them and would encourage you to try them out! If you like litrpg I think they do the system really well and with progression feeling well earned.

As for this cyoa it will probably stay fairly small and without images, its something I wanted to make as I was rereading the series, but there isn't so much book content that I think I can add much more without a lot of creative liberty.

tmpAddon.title: canon_word  canon_word Eidetic Memory
tmpAddon.text: Remember anything you focus your mind on retaining.

rows.titleText: Series by Drew Wells

addons.text:
The guide or system is divided into to main parts for sentients, their race and profession / class. Both can be classified into levels or colors depending on local terminology, starting at Red / 1 and increasing through the rainbow to Orange, Yellow, etc to Violet / 7.

Race:

Race is further distinguished in each tier by ★ rating. The lowest you can be born at is Red ★, increasing to ★★, then ★★★, before evolving to the next tier of Orange ★. At each enhancement, the guide will improve your body and mind, increasing your stats and lifespan through a painful process. Enhancements to the next color are more painful but provide more substantial benefits as well. Starting at Red you will have access to 7 general skill slots, and this will increase by 7 at each major enhancement to a new color, for 14 at Orange ★, 21 at Yellow ★, etc. Experience can be earned by using and improving these skills, and this experience is used to improve your race. The first enhancement to Red ★★ costs 10,000 experience, increasing to 20,000 for Red ★★★, then 40,000 to evolve to Orange ★. All of these race enhancements before reaching orange will improve all your base stats by 20-30% for reference, while the evolution to orange will increase everything around 30-40% by itself. A large jump increases to reach Orange ★★, requiring 100,000, and continuing to increase from there. Profession / Class:

The standard age that professions are unlocked is 14, but this can change depending on the local society or by earning feats from the guide itself to unlock choosing earlier. Professions are earned through your actions and can be better or worse depending on what you have accomplished before your choice. A choice need not be made instantly after unlocking, giving you time to improve your accomplishments if you are dissatisfied. After unlocking a profession, you lose the ability to earn life experience from doing new things, but for most this exp source has become inconsequential compared to general skill exp by this time anyways. Experience for a profession is gained by acting in line with the profession, so smithing for a smith, fighting for a warrior, etc. These categories can be broad with different levels of exp depending on how close an action is to the core of the profession. You also have the option of directing profession experience to the profession level or your race grade at any time.

Professions grant 3 benefits: attributes, skills, and boons. In areas of average power, an individual gaining 2 stat points per level total is considered talented, but extreme talents can earn 3+. Similarly an average person might get one skill at Red, with talents getting 2 and the incredibly talented 3. Earning a boon at red is reserved for the most talented and accomplished individuals. Even these limits can be surpassed though through truly impressive accomplishments and god granted boons, and 3 boons even at red is possible. Professions level up from 1 to 10 before evolving to the next grade, not having ★ ratings like race. When evolving, your class can earn new boons, skills, and stats per level. The first level at Red requires 5000 experience, and this requirement increases by 1000 points for each level in red up to the max of 15,000 at level 10. Each level you gain the stat points as your class has them allocated (Ex: +1 Str, +0.5 Dex, +0.25 Mind, etc.). At Orange the first level requires 16,000 exp, increasing by 2,000 per level, up to 34,000 for level 10. The most skills that can be granted by a profession at Orange is 7. (some guide naming terminology like profession / class or favor / luck changes based on personal or societal understanding, without affecting how it actually works).

objects.title: System
objects.text: Select for detailed information on the Guide, the system of this world that supports your growth.

addons.text: This cyoa is based on the book series Elydes by Drew Wells, which you can find more info on here: https://www.royalroad.com/fiction/67742/elydes I tried to write it so that you wouldn't need to have read the books, but I personally really enjoy them and would encourage you to try them out! If you like litrpg I think this is a great read, they do the system really well and the progression feels well earned. As for this cyoa it will probably stay fairly small and without images, its something I wanted to make as I was rereading the series, but there isn't so much book content that I think I can add much more without a lot of creative liberty. CYOA by xXRaddragonXx

Selecting this indicates in choice titles which options are pulled from canon. Canon choices will be marked with *. These marks indicate that the choice comes from the story, but some things are only briefly hinted at and i'm still making interpretations. A double star, **, indicates the choice is mentioned in the story or heavily implied, but mostly my speculation on the details.

rows.title: Intro
rows.titleText: You are about to be reborn into the world of Elydes. A world of magic and monsters, where both beasts and sentients grow through their access to the guide. The guide is a tracking system and growth aid, cataloging your efforts into skills, an improvable race, and a profession / class. Your skills enhance your natural abilities and grow with use, earning you experience that improves your race or profession, which in turn improve your stats making you stronger and gaining you more skills and skill slots. To help you in the transition, a powerful deity has granted you a source of potential, from which you can make choices here to improve yourself in anticipation of your coming adventures. Make your choices, then explore the world of Elydes!

objects.title: None
objects.text: Gain no assistance, you will be more or less as normal as anyone else. Any bonuses you gain will be earned through quests or drawbacks.

objects.title: Interested
objects.text: The deity is only mildly interested in you, handing over a few points of potential.

objects.title: Favored
objects.text: You are favored by the deity, gaining enough potential for a good deal of benefits.

objects.title: Blessed
objects.text: You are truly blessed by the deity with more than enough points.

objects.title: Godly
objects.text: Receive everything they can give, skip no desired boons.

rows.title: Difficulty
rows.titleText: How much assistance is the deity moving you to Elydes going to provide?

objects.title: Customize Appearance
objects.text: As a one time benefit, you can freely customize your appearance. Those you knew before won't question this transformation. Must remain within the limits of your race, and this is purely cosmetic and will not provide physical benefits.

rows.title: You
rows.titleText: Choices that define who you are.

objects.title: canon_word Human
objects.text: The standard race, no large benefits or drawback. Don't particularly lean towards any affinities. The most common and populous race on Elydes.

objects.title: canon_word Merfolk
objects.text: An amphibious race known for bridging the gap between the more fully aquatic and land based races. They have the ability to breathe water and air. Humanoid but covered in fine scales and with fins to aid in swimming.

objects.title: canon_word Siren
objects.text: An aquatic race living mainly in the deep oceans. They have the ability to breathe water and air. Mostly humanoid but with a scaled tail instead of legs. Known for their natural gifts of charming mental magic and minor transformations (with effort turn tail into legs) which are powered by their connection to the ocean and require being near it. While they can leave the ocean for long stretches of time, sometimes years or decades, sirens must return to the oceans to recover eventually, or risk insanity.

objects.title: canon_word canon_word Elf
objects.text: Like elves out of fantasy stories, these graceful humanoids are naturally inclined towards magic, with greater chances to have high affinities.

objects.title: canon_word canon_word Gnome
objects.text: Small and large eyed with sharp teeth and pointy ears, this race is known for their crafts and dexterous 6 fingered hands with extra joints.

rows.title: Race
rows.titleText: There are many races other than human on the world of Elydes, each with their own benefits. Choose yours here.

rows.title: Starting Grade
rows.titleText: Normally, the race grade you start at depends mostly on luck, with higher odds for higher grades in areas with more mana density. Apart from location and the possibility of your parents using supplements or treasures to improve your odds, there is little you can control. In this section though, determine your own starting grade using points. As a default, you will start at Orange ★, a rare (~1%) but not unheard of circumstance for an average citizen of an average human nation. As an additional benefit, if fate would have lead to you being at a higher grade than your selection here, you can choose to accept that higher grade upon entering the world (not the case if you select an option that gives points).

rows.title: Roll Affinities
rows.titleText: Click this button to roll for affinity points, a special currency used to set your magical affinities in the next section. This will randomize your point value between 20 and 55, so even at the low end you will have above average affinities if distributed intelligently (a few strong affinities is almost always better than many weak ones). Alternatively, forsake the gamble and receive exactly 30 points, knowing that this is less than the expected value of rolling the dice. If you make a mistake (or really regret your decision), an option will appear that allows you to decrease your points by 1 each click until reaching 0. At 0 points this row will reappear.

rows.title: Safe Bet
rows.titleText: Receive exactly 30 affinity points. Lose the ability to roll for more.

objects.title: Affinity Point Conversion
objects.text: Convert 1 point into 4 Affinity points

rows.title: ReRoll Affinities
rows.titleText: Click to reduce affinity points by 1. Use if you misclicked above (or to cheat and reroll). Must not have any affinities chosen for roll option to reappear.

objects.title: canon_word Darkness
objects.text: Related to shadow but focused on Absorption / Consumption

objects.title: canon_word Shadow
objects.text: Related to dark but focused on Hiding / Evasion

objects.title: Other
objects.text: Any other affinity you can think of which fits with the common affinities.

rows.title: Affinities
rows.titleText: Everyone on Elydes is born with affinities towards some forms of elemental magic. These affinities are randomly distributed at birth, ranging in number and intensity. Affinities are broadly distinguished into major and minor, where major affinities are strong enough to center a profession or path around, or more concretely major affinities provide enough connection to an element to perceive it with a newly evolved elemental mana sense skill. These affinities are rated on a 1 to 100 scale, in weaker human factions an affinity of 30 might be considered major, while races with strong magical roots like elves might only consider a score above 50 to be major. A higher affinity towards a type of magic will make it easier to perceive and thus regenerate, to learn to use, and make using that element more powerful and efficient. Determine your affinities here. Each element below can be selected up to 10 times, with each selection equating to 10 points on the 100 point scale, ie maxing a choice to 10 selections is equivalent to a perfect affinity to that element. Affinities get harder and harder to raise as they get higher, and less and less likely to occur naturally as well. Even having 2 major affinities is often considered good luck, and while having more is not a burden, it can lead to spreading oneself too thin as skill slots are limited and earning a profession which uses many mana types is difficult. Minor are often useful for crafting where raw power isn't needed, and for variety at a high level of overall power. There are hundreds of known affinities, many with large overlap. While often similar affinities can be used to work with neighboring types, especially with skill specializations making the process more efficient, it will always be better to have strong affinity to the exact element you want to use. For instance a water mage can manipulate steam and ice, and can get offered a skill evolution to water magic to improve in each of these domains, but will still be less efficient than an ice mage. The lists below are not comprehensive (and are largely head cannon) Click the button above to randomize how your points are spent for a more standard affinity allocating experience or as a challenge (drawback). (Button functionality in editor is not very developed and is hard to restrict without taking away freedom)

objects.title: canon_word canon_word Beast
objects.text: Related to nature but focused on Bonding / Communication with beasts

objects.title: Other
objects.text: Any other affinity you can think of which fits with the uncommon affinities.

rows.title: Uncommon Affinities
rows.titleText: Affinities can also be subjectively categorized by rarity. While not necessarily stronger, uncommon and rare affinities appear less often and thus can sometimes be considered more valuable. They also tend to have more ethereal effects than common elements. The typical defining feature of rarer affinities is that the element they represent is more difficult to find naturally, thus requiring exceptionally high affinities or specialized locations to be able to find mana of the correct type to train with. For example environments rich in water mana are easy to find, near oceans or waterfalls. It is harder to find lightning mana, but could be found during storms. And something like spatial mana might require finding an incredibly rare pocket dimension or mana anomaly.

objects.title: Other
objects.text: Any other affinity you can think of which fits with the rare affinities.

rows.title: Rare Affinities
rows.titleText: Rarer than uncommon affinities, these are the types of mana that can be considered hardest to come by with the strangest affects.

objects.title: Wild
objects.text: The world is less tame, with sentients occupying less of the available space. By default sentients control most of the world, and are present near even the locations too dangerous to live in. Taking this choice will mean more of the world is unexplored and unclaimed.

objects.title: Magical
objects.text: The world is more magical. By default, mana zones where magical energy is rich are somewhat rare. Taking this choice makes them more common and more powerful. Most land will likely be near these areas, meaning more danger from the monsters they grow as well as more treasures to be found.

objects.title: Cavernous
objects.text: The natural caverns that run beneath the surface of the planet are expanded. These caves now provide paths across nearly the whole globe underground, and are mor completely populated and home to unique environments. This new part of the world to explore might come with new treasures as well as new monsters.

objects.title: Large
objects.text: The world is simply larger. Through magic, the size of the planets surface doubles, leading to more places to explore and more societies to learn from or possibly make enemies of.

objects.title: Ancient
objects.text: The world is ancient and the past is well preserved. This choice adds more ruins to the world, containing ancient magical artifacts and treasures. While not all will be undiscovered, there will be may left untouched to this day. While not necessarily all better than modern artifice, some secrets will certainly have been lost to time leading to strange abilities and affects hard to come by elsewhere.

objects.title: Dimensional Hub
objects.text: The world is more dimensionally active giving rise to more hidden realms and spatial anomalies. These realms are often great sources of treasure, holding unique affinities and mana sources, as well as ancient and unique monsters and environments.

objects.title: Dungeons
objects.text: This choice will add dungeons to the world of Elydes, natural convergences of magic which lead to isolated spaces with strange environments and monsters. These dungeons interface with the guide to grant treasures beyond what is created by the natural environment upon completion of the challenges within.

objects.title: Safer
objects.text: Elydes is a dangerous world where monsters are only one of many threats. Taking this option weakens those monsters relative to sentients, as well as reduces the overall risk to you on this world in many ways, such as less competitive and combative societies and more basic resources like clean water and arable land. Take this choice for a more relaxed experience.

objects.title: Dangerous
objects.text: Elydes is a dangerous world where monsters are only one of many threats. Taking this option takes that to the next level. Monsters are slightly more powerful relative to sentients, and there are slightly fewer resources to go around. This makes the world a harsher place to survive.

rows.title: World
rows.titleText: Changes to the world of Elydes and how you arrive.

objects.title: More Powerful Gods
objects.text: Normally gods are quite limited in their power, with weaker gods only giving small boons and even powerful pantheons having limited impact on the world. This choice makes the gods much stronger, and therefore more able to affect the world. In return, their excess power means they will have more power to give, handing out stronger boons and to more people. They will still likely require oaths or contracts from the non devout, but they will be less restrictive.

objects.title: Weaker Gods
objects.text: This choice greatly weakens the gods. They will still exist, but with less power and stronger barriers to their realms. While this means they will have severely limited impact on the world, it also means their gifts and boons will be weaker and harder to obtain.

objects.title: Tricky Gods
objects.text: Gods will all lean towards the nature of a trickster. While not necessarily trying to make mortal life worse, gods will behave more mischievously and will be harder to predict. Expect them to try and lie and cheat if you are making deals for power.

rows.title: Gods
rows.titleText: Elydes is a world that is home to spirits which occupy a realm beyond the physical. These range in power greatly, and are impacted by peoples' beliefs in them. This spirits, or gods, are able to affect the world in a variety of ways, though most often interact with people through the system by granting boons of stats or magical affinity. Choices here impact what these gods can do.

objects.title: Reborn
objects.text: You soul will be reborn in a child's body at birth. Born into a loving family that would accept you even if you told them your real origin. Use your developed mind as an advantage to improve your skills before your peers.

objects.title: Borrowed identity
objects.text: A body will be created with an existing identity for you to take over. They will have randomized stats, skills, and levels around the standard of where you choose to arrive. As a one time benefit you can safely and instantly discard any of these skills or your profession. Your adopted family will be unconcerned about any noticed change in personality.

objects.title: Drop In
objects.text: Get moved to the world of Elydes as is. Gain access to the system and magic with randomized talent based on where you arrive, but your skills and profession will need to be developed from scratch. As a consolation for your delayed start, gain some points and knowledge of the local language. Your body will gain any magical properties it might not otherwise have, such as mana veins and affinities, as well as take on physical characteristics like race chosen elsewhere upon entering the world.

rows.title: Insertion
rows.titleText: Now that the world has been altered, how will you arrive to the world of Elydes?

objects.title: canon_word Merian Republic
objects.text: A somewhat new human faction which has existed for 1500 years. Average in many ways but with a small presence on the world stage. Looking to expand and gain respect among older and more powerful empires. With standard mana density in their main territory, most people are born at Red ★★, with around 10% at Red ★★★, and 1% at Orange ★ or above. Total population of 70 million

objects.title: canon_word Baquaire Archipelago
objects.text: A small island chain recently annexed by the Merian Republic, this is a mostly safe and tropical locale. Attempting to be refurbished into a resort destination by its newly appointed governor, these island host many sites of the Ancient Vastaire civilizations' ruins, including some in the mana zone jungle on the Yanlun, the largest island in the archipelago. Mostly located in a low mana zone, most people are born at Red ★, with few any higher. Total population of 200,000.

objects.title: Deep Ocean
objects.text: Born in the deep ocean to an aquatic race like the sirens. Many civilizations in the ocean never leave it, a whole world lies below the surface. As this is not a specific location, assume a random mana level around the world's average.

rows.title: Entry Point
rows.titleText: Where will you arrive on Elydes?

objects.title: Wealthy Family
objects.text: Your reborn body or constructed persona is part of a powerful family in the entry location you chose. This likely means wealth and teachers dedicated to you, but also will potentially drag you into politics.

objects.title: Destitute
objects.text: Your reborn body or constructed persona is born into poverty. Don't expect wealth or material assistance from your family.

objects.title: Orphaned
objects.text: Your reborn body or constructed persona is born to no family. You will instead be an orphan, taken in by the nearest orphanage to your entry point. Normally this would be decided by luck or the general wealth of your entry point, unless you take other circumstance options which will now apply to the orphanage.

objects.title: Lost for Words
objects.text: You no longer naturally know the language where you arrive. You must learn to speak on your own.

objects.title: Attack
objects.text: Your entry point is under some kind of attack. You and those close to you are likely to survive even if you don't act, but you are still in some danger. If things go poorly, it might have a drastic impact on the area you arrive in. The attack isn't part of a larger threat and will end in a matter of minutes or hours.

objects.title: Upheaval
objects.text: Some sort of long term upheaval is occurring in your location of choice, such as drastic leadership changes or mana levels shifting. This isn't a problem you'll need to deal with quickly, if at all, but it will significantly impacting the area around you.

rows.title: Entry Circumstances
rows.titleText: What is occurring around you when you arrive?

objects.title: Secretive
objects.text: There exist many methods of gaining information about the information recorded by an individual's guide, but by taking this you won't need to fear any. You can design how you want your system to appear when observed, and no method can get around your facade. Also muddles the results of lie detection skills in your desired direction, but not as completely.

objects.title: Skill Level Lock
objects.text: Normally when skills are discarded they return to your guide's bank, but lose all levels you had accumulated. Only levelling a skill to 100 and evolving its grade allows you to maintain your progress by banking the evolved level 1 skill. By taking this choice, any discarded skills will keep their earned levels until you retake them.

objects.title: Smooth Skill Slots
objects.text: Removing skills is a painful and possibly dangerous (even life threatening) process if the skill is more powerful than your race. By taking this choice, your skill slots and the removal process become smooth, making skill removal painless, perfectly safe, and instant.

objects.title: Simple Milestones
objects.text: Skills reach milestones or roadblocks at levels 50, 75, and 100, where the must be evolved / specialized. Typically you can earn a general evolution to the skill to improve all aspects some, or earn specializations, branching out the skill or focusing the improvement on a particular aspect. These options are normally earned through your actions, and it is possible to have none earned when reaching a milestone, requiring more effort before you can evolve. By taking this choice, in addition to earned specializations you will always receive 2 randomized options, as well as always being able to generally improve the skill if there exists a general evolution. Essentially, never get stuck at a skill bottleneck and have more choices, sometimes better than what you earned yourself.

objects.title: Trial Period
objects.text: When the guide presents you options, you can now try out each option for a small period and reverse your decisions with no drawbacks. For skills, you can freely swap between presented evolution options until you reach 5 levels after the milestone. For classes, you can switch between options until you level up once. When a decision has been made and you pass these thresholds, very small pieces of the non selected options will integrate into the selected option as a bonus. (note that at least for general skills, it is often possible to learn to recreate evolution effects manually after experiencing them)

objects.title: Help System
objects.text: The guide contains all manner of skills, professions, and achievements, so much so that any one person knowing everything it encompasses is near impossible. Taking this choice unlocks a help system, allowing you to ask your guide what it offers. Learn of all possible skills, classes, etc. with descriptions and the guide's requirements to earn them. In addition, adds extra information displayed by your guide like affinity values.

objects.title: Skill Merger
objects.text: Normally, learning a skill which overlaps enough with a skill you have slotted in can create a resonance which allows them to merge, typically to replace a lower tier skill with an earned higher tier version. This choice gives you much greater control over that process. At any time, choose skills, slotted or not, which share features and your guide will display if they can be merged and what the result would be. Taking this expands which skills can resonate and be merged beyond what is normally possible. Also improves exp transfer when combining skills, so retained levels are higher.

objects.title: Low Bar
objects.text: The guide normally awards feats for completing difficult or dangerous tasks, and grants you favor as a reward. Taking this option will lower the guides bar, making it easier to earn favor. Expect the standard to earn a feat to be about 25% lower than for others. Earn favor from fights with bad odds or saving a few people, rather than from escaping death sentences and saving towns.

addons.title: Affinity Feats
addons.text: In addition to stats, you can also earn affinity points through feats. Also proportional to favor earned, and harder to earn with higher affinities. Affinities earned based on affinities used or the type of feat completed.

objects.title: Stat Feats
objects.text: Guide feats normally only grant the Favor stat, but by taking this choice it can now award any stat in addition to Favor. When completing feat worthy achievements, in addition to fate you can earn base stats like Strength, Dexterity, etc. Stats earned will be based on main stats used or the type of feat completed. Stat point numbers will be proportional to Favor earned but lower in quantity.

addons.title: One Size
addons.text: All skills now take only one slot.

objects.title: Small Skills
objects.text: Starting at Green, most skills begin to take up more than 1 skill slot. By selecting this choice, reduce the number of slots taken by any skill above 1 by 1. I.E. skills that would take 2 slots now take 1, skills that would take 3 now take 2.

objects.title: Extra Special
objects.text: Skill evolutions / specializations normally only allow you to pick one option. If you wanted something else, you would need to relearn the skill and reach the same level again, and having both would still take up multiple skill slots. This choice allows you to take 2 specializations at each milestone. You can use both choices on the same option to double its effect as well.

objects.title: Extra Boons
objects.text: The amount of boons your profession provides is normally tied to its quality. Each selection of this choice adds a boon onto the profession you eventually choose at each grade, without impacting the ones you earned normally. These additional boons will be related to your profession.

objects.title: Extra Class Skills
objects.text: The amount of profession skills your profession provides is normally tied to its quality. Each selection of this choice adds a profession skill onto the profession you eventually choose at each grade, without impacting the ones you earned normally. These additional skills will be related to your profession.

objects.title: Limitless
objects.text: Despite being incredibly difficult to ever reach, the guide does have a limit at the end of Violet. This choice removes that limit, allowing the guide to let you progress beyond the end of Violet. Experience requirements and skill growth difficulty will increase similarly to grades before, but you can always continue growing them with enough time and effort.

addons.title: Steadier
addons.text: Some of the steadiness rubs off, increasing the range for your instant stat change to 50% away from base.

objects.title: Shifting Stats - Quick and Dirty
objects.text: Gain the ability to move stat points between your attributes. Once every 24 hours, gain the ability to redistribute you stat points from any attribute to any attribute. This happens instantly, but no stat can be further than 25% away from its base value. For example if you started with 10 points of strength, you could only increase it to 12.5 until you truly earned more base strength. Similarly a stat at 10 could not go below 7.5.

addons.title: Quicker
addons.text: Some of the quickness rubs off, increasing the speed of moving base stats permanently, and reducing the focus required.

objects.title: Shifting Stats - Slow and Steady
objects.text: Gain the ability to move stat points between your attributes. Slowly and through intense concentration move a stat point from one attribute type to another. Not a quick process, but grants you complete control over your distribution given time.

objects.title: Bank Dividends
objects.text: Normally skills in your guide's skill bank do nothing, just waiting to be slotted in. Taking this choice changes that, allowing you to receive partial assistance from your skills in the skill bank. While a skill is banked you will receive 33% of its normal effect.

objects.title: Training Slots
objects.text: Gain a special extra skill slot for each race level you reach (1 at Red, 2 total at Orange...). Each of these slots functions different than a normal skill slot. A skill in one of these training slots only grants 25% of the normal effect of the skill, but in exchange grants 100% increased skill growth. In other words, you won't feel much of the effect of having the skill active, but it will grow twice as fast as normal.

objects.title: Extra Skills
objects.text: Normally sentients at Red have 7 general skill slots, and gain 7 general skill slots each race color advancement. Each selection of this choice adds a general skill slot to your base of 7, which also means an extra skill slot each race advancement. That is, with one selection have 8 skill slots at red and 16 at Orange, etc...

objects.title: Custom Class
objects.text: Rather than selecting a class from your guide's presented options, this choice allows you to design your own. Your guide will now keep track of an internal currency of "class points" that are earned by the same type of feats and growth that normally lead to earning better profession options. When you unlock class selection, these points can be spent on stats per level, class skills, and class boons. The options for skills and boons will be based on those you might have earned from class options you qualified for, plus extra variety as a bonus from this choice. The overall strength of your class will be in line with what you could have earned without this choice, it just allows you customization and variety. This customization occurs at each class evolution as well.

addons.title: Profession Level Lock
addons.text: The skill level lock expands to include your profession and skill levels.

objects.title: Class Bank
objects.text: Unlike skills, the guide does not store previously earned professions, likely because it is normally an incredibly dangerous and grueling process to change your profession. This choice makes removing your class easy, safe, and painless, and adds a bank that stores classes you have earned to switch to. Like skills, these classes (and their profession skills) revert to their initial level when removed unless they are evolved to the next color grade.

objects.title: Extra Class
objects.text: Gain an extra profession slot, unlocked when you unlock your regular one. Pick from the professions you have earned. Can be selected at a different time than your other profession if you want to leave the slot open. Other choices that affect professions affect this one as well. Experience is not gained by both professions by default unless you perform actions that fall under both umbrellas.

objects.title: Classic Exp
objects.text: In the world of Elydes, experience is only (*some rare exceptions) earned through improving your skills or performing your profession. Taking this choice adds a new avenue, the classic method of gaining exp from defeating enemies. Gain a very small portion (<1%) of the total experience of any foe you kill, which can be directed towards improving your race or profession.

rows.title: Guide
rows.titleText:
The Guide guides the growth of all sentients and awakened beasts in this world. Choices here affect how your system works.

Receive 2 basic improvements for free.

objects.title: Strength
objects.text: The physical power of your body, how much force your muscles can generate. Each selection here increases the effect of your strength stat by 20%. Going negative decreases the effect by 10%.

objects.title: Dexterity
objects.text:
Control over your body and precision.

Each selection here increases the effect of your dexterity stat by 20%. Going negative decreases the effect by 10%.

objects.title: Constitution
objects.text: Endurance and toughness, how much of a beating you can take. Each selection here increases the effect of your constitution stat by 20%. Going negative decreases the effect by 10%.

objects.title: Mind
objects.text:
Speed of thought, memory, and mental control. Some link to mana control and pool.

Each selection here increases the effect of your mind stat by 20%. Going negative decreases the effect by 10%.

objects.title: Spirit
objects.text: Control, power, and capacity for mana. Each selection here increases the effect of your spirit stat by 20%. Going negative decreases the effect by 10%.

objects.title: Perception
objects.text: Your senses and reactions. See farther, hear more, act faster. Each selection here increases the effect of your perception stat by 20%. Going negative decreases the effect by 10%.

objects.title: Favor
objects.text: How much sway you have over fate. Make circumstances of chance lean in your favor. Each selection here increases the effect of your favor stat by 20%. Going negative decreases the effect by 10%.

rows.title: Stats
rows.titleText: There are 7 stats tracked by the system, with the first 6 considered base stats and luck / favor as a special case. These base stats can be slightly improved while growing up through training and genetics, or potentially rare treasures or potions, but mostly come from race enhancements and evolutions and profession levels. Favor is only earned through the guide by completing feats or through blessings from gods and spirits. Receive one bonus for free.

rows.title: Skills
rows.titleText: Skills both mundane and system tracked can be affected by choices in this section.

rows.title: Mundane Skills
rows.titleText:
Gain experience in these professions without affecting your status. Gain the knowledge of working in these professions for around 5 years under the guidance of a teacher that would be considered proficient anywhere in the world. Gain no skills or skill levels from this knowledge, but the experience should allow you to quickly earn those levels yourself. Expect that any choice made here will be enough accomplishments in that field to earn a profession related to it, though with no further work it would be at the lowest level. These should provide a strong starting point to delve into magical evolutions of these professions.

Receive 1 selection for free.

objects.title: canon_word Any 2 Red Skills
objects.text: Choose any 2 red skills. Red skills are generally quite basic, representing simple or mundane abilities, though not necessarily bad. Examples include running, herbology, keen senses, swordsmanship, etc. Typically the more mundane a skill the harder it is to earn and the more intentional you must be (sleeping for instance is incredibly difficult to earn). Many red skills can be earned in days or weeks, but this option might let you save some time or guarantee your slots aren't filled with unwanted skills before gain the ability to discard them. Slots marked by these skills provide a 5% growth bonus each instead of the full 10% mentioned above.

objects.title: canon_word Basic Orange Upgrade of Red Skill
objects.text: Pick a single orange skill that represents a mostly mundane upgrade to a red skill. Something like [Enhanced Runner] that uses small amounts of mana to generally improve [Running]. other exmaples might be [Awareness] to [Danger Sense] or [Swordsmanship] to [Advanced Swordsmanship].

objects.title: canon_word Elemental Magic
objects.text: Elemental magic skills allow the user to improve their control over a specific affinity. If you want to freely control an element or work it into your other skills or profession, this skill is a must for each element you desire to control. All starting elemental magic skills rate as orange.

objects.title: canon_word Resistance
objects.text: Gain a resistance to a specific phenomena of your choice. Through repeated exposure and persistence, you adapt to resist that phenomena. Some possible resistances are fear, poison, heat, cut, impact.

objects.title: canon_word Mana Sense
objects.text: The key skill required to understand magic and eventually become a mage, but also widely useful in nearly all professions. Sensing mana is the first step to controlling mana, which is the basis for nearly all high level skills and professions. This skill improves your perception of mana, allowing you to perceive it with an omnidirectional 6th sense. Start by sensing unattuned mana, but nearly all mages quickly evolve the skill to see elemental mana.

objects.title: canon_word Mana Manipulation
objects.text: The foundational skill required to manipulate magic and eventually become a mage, but also widely useful in nearly all professions. Controlling mana and infusing it into other skills is the basis for nearly all high level skills and professions. This skill improves your manipulation of mana, allowing you to finely control it and shape it into constructs. Start by controlling unattuned mana which can enhance many physical actions, and is an easy way to improve mundane skills.

objects.title: canon_word canon_word Multitasking
objects.text: Split your focus and perform multiple tasks at once. Useful for spellcasters and crafters.

objects.title: canon_word Alchemy
objects.text: Use all kinds ingredients together with your mana to concoct alchemical creations.

objects.title: canon_word Inspect
objects.text: Be it through mana or sight, nothing will escape your eyes and mind. Focus your perception on a target to glean more information about it and better understand it.

objects.title: canon_word canon_word Chanting
objects.text: Chanting is the utilization of a language of power to manifest myriad magical effects. Through speaking words, shape your magic for greater control and breadth. Though be wary, a misspoken word can have drastic consequences, and speaking perfectly is difficult under pressure.

objects.title: canon_word Treasure Sense
objects.text: Develop a sixth sense for finding treasure and valuable goods. Tied to fate and perception, this skill leads you towards valuables and helps you find what you are looking for.

objects.title: canon_word Swift Learner
objects.text: Your mind grasps new subjects with uncanny speed. Every mistake becomes a stepping stone; every lesson an opportunity for understanding. The skill is especially effective in absorbing entirely new knowledge in an easily digestible form.

addons.title: canon_word canon_word Familiar Bond
addons.text: This skill must be at or above the tier of the beast you initially use it on to work.

objects.title: canon_word canon_word Familiar Bond
objects.text: Form a bond with a monster that connects you as equals. Communicate mentally across the bond, and share more of yourselves with each other as it grows stronger. Beasts tend to gain more intelligence, as humans gain instincts, stats, or even affinities from powerful enough monsters.

addons.title: canon_word canon_word Eidetic Memory
addons.text: Remember anything you focus your mind on retaining.

objects.title: canon_word Mnemonic Memory
objects.text: Lock your knowledge and retrieve it at will. You can memorize vast amounts of information and recall details even under pressure. Using patterns, mental maps, images or codes boosts effectiveness.

addons.title: canon_word Mana Engraving
addons.text: Master enchanters know only the runes shaped directly into the essence of their craft may aim for everlasting enchantments. Form runes directly in the mana of magical materials for stronger and more permanent effects.

objects.title: canon_word Runes
objects.text: The creation and memorization of runes, written languages of power that can be drawn, engraved, woven, etc into an object to permanently add magical effects.

addons.title: canon_word canon_word Fate's Intuition
addons.text: Upgrade your danger sense to tap into fate through your Favor stat. Get hints of danger occurring before it starts and works on a wider range of danger sources. Works better with a higher Favor stat, especially when higher than your enemies' Favor.

objects.title: canon_word Danger Sense
objects.text: Passively direct your senses towards detecting danger. Feel when you are being targeted or where an attack is coming from before it hits.

rows.title: General Skills
rows.titleText: The bread and butter of the guide, these skills are earned through performing an action adequately, and help you to improve that action. All general are things you can do without the guide's help, but the guide makes your effort to improve concrete, assisting you in these skills and guiding their growth at milestones. As general skills grow they become more efficient and versatile, as well as providing more assistance to you when using that skill. At red sentients have 7 general skill slots, increasing by 7 each color grade they rise. Taking skills from this section serves to populate those slots, not add new ones, saving you the time, difficulty, or special circumstances needed to acquire them, as well as give an idea of what's possible. Additionally, Orange skills chosen here mark the skill slot they are initially placed in. This mark permanently increases the speed the skill in that slot grows by 10%, even if you eventually replace that initial skill. Yellow skills mark their slot with a 20% growth boost instead. Grade of the skills in this section denoted by color of the name, Orange name -> Orange skill. Receive 2 choices for free.

objects.title: Message
objects.text: Mark people you have communicated with in person, and activate this skill to open telepathic communication with them. Level increases number of active marks, range of communication (starts high, miles). Evolutions might allow worldwide messaging or use as a mental attack.

objects.title: canon_word canon_word Magic Missile
objects.text: A simple, powerful, and efficient magical projectile. Condense your unattuned mana into a projectile and launch it. Levels increase power, efficiency, and control. Evolutions might attune the bolt, add homing or greater control capabilities.

objects.title: Elemental Manipulation
objects.text: Manipulate an element of your choosing similar to the [Elemental Magic] option above. As a profession skill though, this utilizes your unattuned mana instead of the corresponding elemental mana, and does not rely on your affinity.

objects.title: Pocket Space
objects.text: Open a portal to a personal pocket space. As the skill levels, increase the size of the space and your control over it, with evolutions gaining abilities like time warping inside, splitting into separate spaces, and creating a livable atmosphere. Starts at a large backpack size.

objects.title: Grasp Air
objects.text: Solidify any air you are making physical or mana contact with instantly. Create barriers or platforms to walk in the air. Levels improve efficiency and durability, evolutions might allow maintaining solidified air without contact for invisible ranged projectiles.

objects.title: canon_word canon_word Blink
objects.text: A short range low cooldown teleport. Instantly move to a location within the range of your mana sense. Levels increase range and efficiency. Evolutions might allow bringing more with you, travelling farther, or controlling momentum when blinking.

objects.title: Teleport
objects.text: A long range high cooldown teleport. Mark locations with your mana and store them in a mental bank. By focusing for a short duration, you can teleport incredibly long distances to these marked points. Mana cost does increase with distance but slowly. Number of storable locations, efficiency, and cast speed increase with level. Evolutions might allow bringing others along or ability to create marks from descriptions or paintings / photos.

objects.title: canon_word Mana Echo
objects.text: Create an echo of a mana construct or casting you've observed to reproduce it at will. The quality and quantity of the copies is determined by the level of this skill. Copies are stored in a mental space attached to the skill with limited size, more complicated constructs take more space. This space increases with level.

objects.title: Cloak
objects.text: Cloak yourself, blending into the background and muffling sound. Levels improve the cloaking, making you more perfectly invisible. Evolutions might hide more aspects, such as your mana or physicality.

objects.title: Morph
objects.text: Minorly transform the appearance of your body, with a focus on the face. Face can be completely transformed with time and some artistry, and small body modifications can be made. Levels improves efficiency, speed, and range of transformations. Evolutions might allow storing presets, or transforming your body in non human ways.

objects.title: Clone
objects.text: Create an insubstantial clone able to think for itself, returns memories to you on dissolution. Levels increase the substance of the clone (portion of your strength it receives), and the number you can create at once. Evolutions might allow clones to level your skills while active or share a single hive mind for perfect coordination.

objects.title: canon_word canon_word Lie Detection
objects.text: Detect untruth in the words of others. Fell when they are being dishonest and what they are leaving out. Levels improve clarity of this sense, and ability to see through concealments. Evolutions might allow more general intent detection without words.

rows.title: Profession Skills
rows.titleText: Profession skills are a step beyond general skills, rather than improving something you can already do, these skills enable you to do things you couldn't at all before. Normally, these skills are tied to a profession and fall within that profession's scope, and more can only be gained by evolving said profession. In this section you can choose profession skills unrelated to your eventual class. Anything chosen here will eventually get tied to the profession you pick, granting exp towards it like a normal class skill, but will serve as a pure addition, not taking away the slot from the normal skills your class would grant. When reaching milestones professions, like skills, can be evolved / specialized. Most options below have specializations listed to serve as guidelines, but the evolutions you earn depend on how you use the skill and are not limited to those mentioned. The average person will receive a single profession skill when earning their red profession, and talented individuals can earn 2. A profession typically gains more as it evolves. These all start at Red level 1.

objects.title: canon_word canon_wordElemental Attunement
objects.text: Select an element to be attuned to. You naturally regenerate mana of that element's type, and gain an instinctual understanding of how it works. Provides a slight boost in affinity (does not show up in you section). Taking multiple times is for different elements, not for stacking.

objects.title: canon_word canon_word Warriors Retribution
objects.text: Increase your physical stats as you gain injuries. The more hurt you are, the stronger, tougher, and more dexterous and perceptive you become.

rows.title: Profession Boons
rows.titleText: Boons are the other aspect of growth tied to your profession. Boons provide passive benefits in accordance with the profession's goals. It is very rare and difficult to earn a boon for a Red profession but possible. More can be earned as your profession evolves. Add boons on to your profession here.

objects.title: Polyglot
objects.text: Understand and learn languages much quicker. Instantly know the local language where you appear on Elydes, and gain the talent to learn others much easier. Does apply to arcane languages.

objects.title: Sound Sleep
objects.text: While Constitution does lower your need for sleep, this choice greatly improves that effect. This choice will halve your required need for sleep on top of Constitutions reduction, as well as allow you to instantly fall asleep on command. Additionally, control how long you sleep, and always wake feeling energized instead of groggy. No matter your conditions, you also always sleep soundly.

objects.title: Majorly Minor
objects.text: Receive a minor affinity to ALL elements. This will not display in the affinities section, so think of it as having a random affinity from 1-9 for every possible type of mana. Does work with already selected types, so you could go from 50 affinity to 53 if you already invested 5 points in a type in the affinity section.

objects.title: Quick Uptake
objects.text: Learning new skills is easy for you. It takes you 50% of the effort of a regular person to be granted a skill by the guide. Does not impact skill growth after the skill is acquired.

objects.title: Sense Control
objects.text: Gain the ability to tone down your senses, including your sense of pain. Turn off your pain response while enduring excruciating race evolutions, or lower you other senses after a perception boost to avoid the jarring extremes that come with improving this stat.

objects.title: Infogenesis
objects.text: Through study of anything, gather information about it beyond what is natural. The longer you study something, and the better your perception and perceptive skills, the more you will learn about it, going as far as learn information that your skills couldn't normally reveal. With enough time all secrets can be revealed.

objects.title: Satiated
objects.text: You no longer need food and water to survive, your body sustains itself on a negligible amount of mana. Your body maintains your preferred physique due to this. Food instead now is digested into mana, boosting your regeneration slightly, more so from magical foods.

addons.title: Immortal
addons.text: Become agelessly immortal. Stop aging after reaching your physical prime

objects.title: Long Lived
objects.text: Double your life expectancy by slowing down aging after reaching adulthood. This effect stacks on the lifespan granted by race evolutions.

objects.title: Regenerating Body
objects.text: Your body can now completely regenerate from any type of wound. Does not speed regeneration but teeth, limbs, scars, etc. will eventually grow back.

objects.title: Regenerating Mind
objects.text: Your mind is now sturdier and can recover from any damage. Mental attacks and brain damage are only temporary, and even active mind control will become impossible to maintain given enough time. Does not give perfect memory, memories or parts of your personality lost due to mental damage will eventually recover.

objects.title: Sovereign
objects.text: Your fate is controlled by you alone. Some powerful skills and magics can interfere with fate, but with this choice they cannot change yours. Only your own actions impact your future. Also keeps your own favor from being muted. Skills that use your favor and general intuition provided by the stat cannot be restricted.

addons.title: Elemental Regen
addons.text: Add an additional regeneration for elemental mana types. This regen is based on your affinity to each element, and caps at 50% of your unattuned regen at max affinity.

objects.title: Mana Spring
objects.text: You generate your own mana at a rate equivalent to what you could actively regenerate when focused in an area of completely average mana density. Normally mana is regenerated by absorbing it from the environment. With this skill even in mana starved regions you can regenerate, and you can push your regeneration farther when actively generating too.

objects.title: Mana Well
objects.text: You can store 50% more mana than your body would otherwise hold, and the storage of mana has been decoupled from your physical body. Normally, since mana is stored in the body and is passively used to exist, dropping below 50% of your maximum mana can be dangerous. This perk allows you to use every drop of mana without damaging your body, and with the bonus on top effectively serves as having 3x normal reserves.

objects.title: Mana Converter
objects.text: You are able to convert mana between elemental affinities. Normally, elemental mana is restored by collecting motes of a specific elemental energy, where these motes are more common in areas of that particular element. With this ability, all elemental energies can be converted between each other, at a rate of conversion equivalent to your normal rate of gathering. Unattuned mana can also be converted to attuned mana at a 50% efficiency loss.

objects.title: Elemental Weaver
objects.text: Mixing elemental magics is possible through practice, but you are a true talent at weaving the elements together. With this choice, you can easily learn to cast spells combining even the most disparate elements. Beyond just layering different magics onto each other, this choice lets you combine elements into one, and slightly strengthens and lessens the cost of your spells when you do so.

objects.title: True Creation
objects.text: Push your magic beyond what is normally possible, creating permanent matter from your mana. At a high cost, create small amounts of matter that fall under the umbrella of your element. High skill and affinity improve the efficiency. At an even higher cost, elements without (and with) naturally occurring forms of matter under their umbrella can be manifested into esoteric materials fitting their nature.

objects.title: Magical Talent
objects.text: You become talented with mana, learning and improving magical skills easier. All skills with magical aspects progress 25% faster.

objects.title: Martial Talent
objects.text: You become talented in combat, learning and improving martial skills easier. All skills with a focus on fighting or combat progress 25% faster.

objects.title: Crafting Talent
objects.text: You become talented at creation and innovation, learning and improving crafting skills easier. All skills with a focus on creating or understanding goods progress 25% faster.

objects.title: Silver Tongue
objects.text: Well-spoken and persuasive, your tongue never fails you. You have a talent for saying the right thing at the right time. Also makes you much less likely to flub your words when speaking, even using languages of power.

objects.title: Upper hand
objects.text: Your hands experience all of your stats twofold. The increased Dexterity will make art or rune carving precise, and the Strength and Constitution will serve you in fights. Magic cast directly from your hands will see the benefit as well.

objects.title: Generalist Specialist
objects.text: Normally, skills that have a large domain are harder to learn. A skill with many subcategories requires improving all of those subcategories to improve, making them impractical often. Taking this boon allows such skills to grow at a regular rate through use of only specific subcategories, while still granting proficiency in all parts of the skills domain. For instance the [Weapon Master] skill is known to be nearly impossible to level (and therefore pointless), as it covers too many weapons to train, but for you just training with a sword would level the skill.

objects.title: More Exp
objects.text: Simply receive more experience for your actions. Anything that would grant you experience now grants you 25% more (additive).

objects.title: Unbound
objects.text: Your skills and magic cannot be restrained. Some items and powerful profession skills or magics are able to limit your use of mana and skills, but these methods don't work on you.

objects.title: Detox
objects.text: Nearly immune to poisons and disease, your body naturally detoxifies itself. Nearly impossible to get sick or damaged from poisons and venoms not significantly above your level. Improves with your Constitution stat.

addons.title: Aura of Improvement
addons.text: Your mana gains the natural ability to improve. By infusing large amounts of mana into in inanimate object, it can be slowly improved in the direction you desire. (Sword becomes sharper, metal harder, pillow softer). More powerful objects take longer and more mana.

objects.title: Aura of Repair
objects.text: Your mana gains a natural ability to repair. By infusing your mana into inanimate objects, it will slowly return them to an undamaged, pristine state. Works on anything, but slower on objects of greater power.

objects.title: Stifled Presence
objects.text: Any of your actions are hard to detect when desired. Your senses, both physical and magical, can't be detected even by someone with skills to help them. Your physical presence is also muted, making you harder to detect and track (scaling with Dex and Spirit), but not nearly as completely. Similarly your skills are harder to detect as well, both physical and magical, but to an even smaller extent.

objects.title: True Sight
objects.text: See through illusions and small obstructions. Unless the originator is far stronger than you, see when something is a magical construct and see through limiting obstructions like smoke and fog. Improves with Perception stat and works with gained senses like Mana Sense.

objects.title: Antimemetic
objects.text: Your secrets work to stay secret. Any information you don't want others to know about you will slowly fade away. Memories about your stats and skills leave your enemies' minds faster than they should, and written documents seem to go missing or find themselves damaged. This process does take time though, an enemy wont forget your capabilities while you stand in front of them.

objects.title: Oathbreaker
objects.text: Binding oaths exist in this world and are to be wary of. Taking this choice allows you freedom within these oaths. Any vow, be it to mage or god, does not bind you as tightly as the wording states, allowing you to skirt the rules. In addition, this choice wears down all oaths over time. Whether an oath has an ending condition or not, it will eventually lose all hold over you. Takes longer the stronger the being the oath is to. The other party cannot sense this process.

objects.title: Progenitor
objects.text: Your boons and guide benefits can be passed on to children, as well as those you share a very strong bond with. For children the process is natural, for those not of your blood, these gifts will spread with intention over a long time spent together, sped by deep bonds. Skills such as a familiar bond speed up this process greatly. Also can pass along some magical affinity and improves chances for children to be born at higher grades.

objects.title: Loosened Limiter
objects.text: While stats can be trained, their growth through training tends to fall off quite significantly after reaching physical maturity, only growing through extreme use and rarely even then. This choice significantly lessens that limit, making stat training viable even at the highest grades. Improving stats will still take great effort and dedication, but will always be a viable way to improve your stats without levelling.

objects.title: Magical Muscle
objects.text: Normally, magical affinities cannot be trained, only improved with boons and treasures. This choice changes that. Through intense training in the use of an elemental affinity, that affinity can be improved. Slowly and with great effort, but possible to increase even high affinities which become harder to raise the higher they are.

objects.title: Extra Lives
objects.text: Each year stockpile an extra life. When dying consume one life and respawn exactly as you were one week before that death, maintaining only your memories.

objects.title: Save Points
objects.text: Gain the ability to create 3 save points in time, manually or given a set of conditions. You can return to these save points manually or automatically on conditions like death. Lose physical progress and progress tracked in your guide when returning to a save point, but keep your memories.

rows.title: Boons
rows.titleText: Spend points to gain a variety of benefits beyond the system and skills. Receive 2 basic boons for free.

objects.title: Suspiciously Poignant Guidebook
objects.text: This guidebook starts out completely blank, but as you learn skills its pages start to fill in. For each skill you have, this book describes best practices for training, as well as instructions on how to guide skills towards the enhancement best suited for you. As you improve, the pages get more detailed, adding new exercises to fit your higher level. Once you gain a profession, the book also assits in improving it. The book never seems to grow larger, but also never runs out of pages.

objects.title: Reclass Pill
objects.text: Upon eating this pill, the guide will prompt you with what your profession options are. If you decide you want one of these options, it will safely and painlessly remove your current class to replace it with your choice (usually an incredibly difficult process). If you aren't satisfied with the options, you can delay the choice by a year up to 5 times. After the fifth year, you can choose one of the options or keep your original class. Taking the pill also gives a slight boost to your achievements in the eyes of the guide, improving your profession options slightly.

objects.title: Guide Backdoor
objects.text: Activate this single use device to open a backdoor into the guide, unlocking all of its features immediately. The guide normally slowly unlocks as you age, typically granting partial access to skill removal and cosmetic customization at 7 and professions at 14 (though special circumstances can allow earlier). This backdoor unlocks all features instantly as well as maintaining your ability to gain feats that are normally locked after these features are unlocked. For instance taking a profession before 14 but earning feats like slay a red beast without a profession. Lasts until age 14 where normal restrictions reapply, then permanently provides slightly higher rewards for earned feats.

objects.title: AI Plugin
objects.text: An artificial intelligence addon that piggybacks off of your connection to the guide. Is super intelligent and aligned with your goals, but cannot interact with the physical world without controlling your body. Utilizes your senses but can notice things you don't and can activate skills on its own. Its connection to the guide allows it to slightly tweak options you earn in your desired direction (i.e. classes and specializations).

objects.title: Universal Documents
objects.text: These documents mark you as a citizen anywhere you go. Somehow, matching papers have found themselves inside the systems of all the countries that track this information, while also not giving away any of your personal details you wouldn't want known.

objects.title: Universal School Voucher
objects.text: This voucher guarantees entry to any school or guidance from any teacher free of charge and without any normal restrictions or requirements. If a person or institution has taught students or apprentices before, they will also accept you as a student. This voucher is not single use. Does not make teachers like you, but they will earnestly try to help you improve as long as you are an earnest learner.

objects.title: Chimera Egg
objects.text: Inside this egg sits unformed potential. Decide what kind of creature you want to hatch and it will eventually emerge. You can decide after any amount of time. The creature that hatches will have a natural bond with you, seeing you like a parent or sibling. If you pick something too strong you should ensure you know how to form a true familiar bond before it grows up, as most monster species start to compete with even their own kind eventually.

objects.title: Stat Seeds
objects.text: Consuming one of these seeds will give you extra, allocatable, stat points for each profession level. Each seed gives points equal to additional 1/3 of your profession's total per level (minimum of 1, rounded up to nearest .25), but unlike your profession attributes these points can be freely allocated each level. Can split the points into denominations of 0.25.

objects.title: canon_word Spatial Ring
objects.text: This cloaked spatial ring appears as a completely ordinary silver ring to any type of scan, and connects you to a 10' x 10' x 10' space you can use to store and summon items. Time is frozen for items inside.

objects.title: canon_word Fate Fulcrum
objects.text: An extremely rare and poorly understood device that gives slight control over fate. Gathers fate over time based on how high your favor attribute is, and can be activated to use that fate in an area or on your person. Can control the amount of fate used and the duration. Using the fate comes with little control, mostly making uncommon occurrences, both good and bad, much more likely, but a high favor stat can tip those uncommon occurrences in your favor.

objects.title: Chromium Piggybank
objects.text: This artifact is able to convert mana into chromium. Chromium is the most commonly used currency for high level trade across the continents of Elydes, and is special in that the metal it is made from can naturally be found at each grade. This pocket sized piggybank converts mana into chromium coins, and can passively absorb your excess mana (even inside a spatial artifact). An average mage could passively expect it to produce around 1 chromium coin of their grade per year. Know that Red chromium is worth about as much as gold, where 10 gold mesars (coins) in the Merian Rebublic is enough to buy a nice unenchanted house in most cities. An Orange chromium is worth 10 times as much, and Yellow 10 times Orange...

objects.title: Fate's Compass
objects.text: This compass points to what you are searching for when you hold it. It taps into fate to find even immaterial or vague concepts you desire. To do this, it uses your own Favor stat though. It's range and ability to find well concealed or complicated targets grows with your Favor.

objects.title: Living Weapon
objects.text: A weapon that can grow alongside you, this tool starts as a small metal dagger, but will grow and shape itself as you use it. Through use, its material will improve, eventually growing magical. Similarly its shape will change as you use it to fit your fighting style and weapon of choice. Channeling magic through this weapon will eventually imbue it with enchantments or an affinity matching your own.

objects.title: Affinity Constitutor
objects.text: A device which can create affinity treasures, a rare and valuable class of items able to improve natural affinities. By feeding large quantities of attuned mana to this constitutor, it can produce an affinity treasure of that type. Be warned though, even with a major affinity collecting attuned mana for weeks might only produce a treasure that raises an affinity from 0 to 1 (still an item likely worth golds). Like normal affinity treasures, those produced by this constitutor work better the lower the affinity is for the consumer. The treasures produced by this device become significantly weaker after an affinity reaches 30.

rows.title: Items
rows.titleText:
Powerful artifacts that will assist you towards a wide variety of goals. These items cannot be broken (or wont be damaged before use for consumables) and will always find their way back to you if lost.

You are granted 2 basic items for free.

addons.title: Stagnant
addons.text: Your Strength will eventually reach 5 as you grow into an adult, leaving you slightly below average for an unmagical Earth human, but will never progress beyond that point. No methods can increase your strength stat permanently.

objects.title: Weak
objects.text: Your Strength stat starts at 2 (level of a toddler) and cannot be improved through physical training or growth. You won't grow stronger without magic or stat points from a profession or boon, or race evolution, but at high levels most points come from a profession anyways.

addons.title: Stagnant
addons.text: Your Dexterity will eventually reach 5 as you grow into an adult, leaving you slightly below average for an unmagical Earth human, but will never progress beyond that point. No methods can increase your Dexterity stat permanently.

objects.title: Clumsy
objects.text: Your Dexterity stat starts at 2 (level of a toddler) and cannot be improved through physical training or growth. You won't grow stronger without magic or stat points from a profession or boon, or race evolution, but at high levels most points come from a profession anyways.

addons.title: Stagnant
addons.text: Your Constitution will eventually reach 5 as you grow into an adult, leaving you slightly below average for an unmagical Earth human, but will never progress beyond that point. No methods can increase your Constitution stat permanently.

objects.title: Frail
objects.text: Your Constitution stat starts at 2 (level of a toddler) and cannot be improved through physical training or growth. You won't grow stronger without magic or stat points from a profession or boon, or race evolution, but at high levels most points come from a profession anyways.

addons.title: Stagnant
addons.text: Your Mind will eventually reach 5 as you grow into an adult, leaving you slightly below average for an unmagical Earth human, but will never progress beyond that point. No methods can increase your Mind stat permanently.

objects.title: Dim
objects.text: Your Mind stat starts at 4 (level of an adolescent) and cannot be improved through physical training or growth. You won't grow stronger without magic or stat points from a profession, boon, or race evolution, but at high levels most points come from a profession anyways.

addons.title: Stagnant
addons.text: Your Spirit will eventually reach 5 as you grow into an adult, leaving you slightly weak for a Red ★ adult, but will never progress beyond that point. No methods can increase your Spirit stat permanently.

objects.title: Mundane
objects.text: Your Spirit stat starts at 1 (level of a baby or very young child) and cannot be improved through physical training or growth. You won't grow stronger without magic or stat points from a profession or boon, or race evolution, but at high levels most points come from a profession anyways.

addons.title: Stagnant
addons.text: Your Perception will eventually reach 5 as you grow into an adult, leaving you slightly below average for an unmagical Earth human, but will never progress beyond that point. No methods can increase your Perception stat permanently.

objects.title: Oblivious
objects.text: Your Perception stat starts at 2 (level of a toddler) and cannot be improved through physical training or growth. You won't grow stronger without magic or stat points from a profession or boon, or race evolution, but at high levels most points come from a profession anyways.

addons.title: Stagnant
addons.text: Your luck can never improve. You cannot earn favor. Note that -5 favor likely amounts to just slightly bad luck, as gifted individuals can reach into the hundreds of the favor stat through feats without everything going their way.

objects.title: Unlucky
objects.text: Your favor stat starts at -5. An average person is born with a favor of 0, so you will be unlucky until you earn enough feats to return positive.

addons.title: Permanent
addons.text: You cannot increase your affinity to any common elements, they will always be stuck at 0.

objects.title: Fancy Mage
objects.text: You cannot start with affinity for any common elements in this CYOA. (Warning: hides common affinities, so clear your choices in that section first)

addons.title: Permanent
addons.text: You cannot increase your affinity to any uncommon elements, they will always be stuck at 0.

objects.title: Peripheral Mage
objects.text: You cannot start with affinity for any uncommon elements in this CYOA. (Warning: hides uncommon affinities, so clear your choices in that section first)

addons.title: Permanent
addons.text: You cannot increase your affinity to any rare elements, they will always be stuck at 0.

objects.title: Basic Mage
objects.text: You cannot start with affinity for any rare elements in this CYOA. (Warning: hides rare affinities, so clear your choices in that section first)

objects.title: Fresh Start
objects.text: Forget anything you knew about the world of Elydes, including information learned during this CYOA. Enter the world as a complete mystery with a fresh start, but remember your choices.

objects.title: Unarmed
objects.text: You cannot wield weapons when you fight. You must use your bare hands or magic to attack enemies.

objects.title: Unarmored
objects.text: You cannot wear armor when in combat. Clothes and gear can worn and be enchanted in any ways that don't provide protection violent harm. Equipment intended to protect you from attacks of any variety cannot be donned.

objects.title: Self Made
objects.text: You can only use combat equipment you made yourself. Any weapons or armors you use to fight must be something you created.

objects.title: Self Motivated
objects.text: Your guide loses most all of its detail in regards to progression. No longer see skill levels, experience points, or profession levels. Does not affect choices when reaching milestones, but you will have no knowledge of when milestones are close until you reach them.

objects.title: Monster Magnet
objects.text: Beasts are drawn to you like a magnet. Their sense tell them that you are a delicacy or key to their growth, and they will track you down to find you. Does not make you easier to sense for monsters, but if they notice you it will take a great deal to shake them off. Even timid monsters that would normally run when sensing something more powerful will chase after you.

objects.title: Stubborn Skills
objects.text: Learning new skills is harder for you. Expect the effort required to be granted a new skill to be 50% higher than normal. Does not affect growth once a skill is listed in your guide.

objects.title: Magical Pacifist
objects.text: Your magic is not a tool meant for violence. While you can still learn and use magic, you cannot use it to directly attack enemies. You can still use magic to defend, evade, restrain, or for any utility, just not to harm others.

objects.title: Fewer Skills
objects.text: Normally sentients at Red have 7 general skill slots, and gain 7 general skill slots each race color advancement. Each selection of this choice removes a general skill slot from your base of 7, which also means one fewer extra skill slot each race advancement. That is, with one selection have 6 skill slots at red and 12 at Orange, etc...

addons.title: Truly Minor
addons.text: The affinity cap is lowered to 30, meaning you are truly stuck with only minor affinities. At you strongest you just touch the boundary of a major affinity.

objects.title: Minor League
objects.text: Your magical affinities have a cap at 50. While still considered a major affinity in most parts of the world, you won't be a true master of any element and even with treasures your magical talent has an upper bound. (non enforceable, be careful to not cheat)

addons.title: Truly Slow
addons.text: Your starting cap is lowered to 30, you can barely start with major affinities.

objects.title: Slow Start
