objects.text: You cannot start with magical affinities above 50. While they can still grow if you manage to find treasures or receive boons, you must accomplish that growth after your choices are made. (non enforceable, be careful to not cheat)

addons.title: Dangerous Removal
addons.text: The danger is increased, becoming truly deadly when removing skills at your tier. Expect gashes and broken bones from skills even slightly below your grade level. Removing a skill is now risking your life.

addons.title: No Removal
addons.text: You can no longer remove skills at all. Plan your skill path very carefully. A a consolation you can reject earned skills from birth, rather than needing to wait until 7.

objects.title: Strenuous Removal
objects.text: Skill removal becomes a more strenuous process. Beyond just spiritual, the damage caused when removing skills now gains a physical aspect, battering and cutting at your body. Ensure you're prepared to be put through the ringer for skills at your grade.

objects.title: Hard Mode
objects.text: The aspects of your guide which require experience to evolve (race and profession) require twice as much. Each selection of this choice raises the level when this drawback stops applying by one grade. For example, one selection means your Red race and profession require double exp, 2 selections means you require double into Orange, 3 through Yellow, etc.

objects.title: Random Affinities
objects.text: Instead of choosing your affinities they are assigned randomly. In the You section, affinities can only be applied by using the random buttons (This cannot be enforced by this cyoa, must empty section yourself and follow the rule). You can still select which rarity of mana affinity you want to roll your points within freely. If "Other" is randomly rolled it can be treated as a "free space" and reassigned to an affinity of your choice in that rarity. If neighbor affinities are rolled (earth & stone, water & ice, etc.), you can choose to have one "consume" the other, moving all the points into one of the group, as this is often how it works on Elydes for similar affinities. Use your discretion to decide if elements are similar enough. More common elements can consume less common elements, but not vice versa (i.e. Force consumes Gravity, but Beast can't consume Nature ).

rows.title: Drawbacks
rows.titleText: Take drawbacks upon yourself to gain more points to spend elsewhere. These drawbacks cannot be undone, only mitigated through non restricted means if that is within the bounds of the drawback(for example: reaching a high level [Tough Body] skill to lessen effects of low endurance, though no level of sword skill could undo "Unarmed"). Do note though that skills and professions become harder to improve when the stats, skills, and affinities they utilize are much weaker than what you are tying to level.

objects.title: Against All Odds
objects.text: Through your own efforts raise your race from the bottom of Red ★ to Orange ★ before the standard age for unlocking your first seal (7). (Guide awards +5 Favor)

objects.title: Skilled
objects.text: Through your own efforts evolve a Red skill to Orange before the standard age for unlocking your first seal (7). (Easier Guide version to reach first milestone awards +2 Favor)

objects.title: Talented Craftsman
objects.text: Create an item that would be appraised as beyond your grade without a specialized profession. (Similar feat rewards +1 Favor)

objects.title: Monster Hunter
objects.text: Defeat a Red awakened beast in solo combat before earning your profession. (Guide grants +1 Favor)

objects.title: Yellow Pioneer
objects.text: Obtain a yellow-tier skill before unlocking your second seal (age 14, when you can select a profession). (Guide grants +1 Favor)

objects.title: Daring Haggler
objects.text: Speak to and negotiate a deal with at least a minor deity. (Guide awards +5 Favor)

objects.title: Intrepid Explorer
objects.text: Find or rediscover a never visited or long lost dimension or ruin. (Guide awards +10 Favor)

objects.title: Green Prodigy
objects.text: Reach a race grade of Green before turning 21. Most adults don't even reach green in their life, and a Green is considered strong anywhere. You must hit this lofty goal only 7 years after most cultures would consider you an adult.

objects.title: Bound Breaking Fighter
objects.text: Defeat someone in real combat who is a full grade above you alone. Counts both your race and profession, so Red profession and Orange Race would have to beat at least Orange profession Yellow Race.

rows.title: Quests
rows.titleText: Complete these challenging quests to gain points without downsides if you can. Can be selected here for planning, but points will be earned upon completion, allowing you to reopen this menu to spend them. Many of the quests below are also system Feats, which are guide recognized accomplishments that grant you favor. This section should give an idea of what Feats look like so that you can earn more once you arrive in Elydes.

objects.title: Clear All
objects.text: Warning: Clears All selections

objects.title: Known Issues
objects.text: • general lack of control with buttons, no ways I know to disable the button given certain conditions or change what button does based on choices

rows.title: Extra
rows.titleText: Meta: not part of cyoa, controls and information

rows.title: Discount Functions
rows.titleText: Row used to store choices providing discounts on certain rows

defaultRowText: This is a row, and inside of it, you can place choices. On both rows and choices Requirements can be placed, which will block a row from being viewed, or make the player unable to select a choice, depending on either Point-types or the Ids of other choices. Point-types can be made in Features then Manage Points. Hovering over buttons will explain what they do. The Design of the project can be changed in 'Modify Design' at the side navigation bar, and private styling for each row can be turned on in the rows Settings. Default text like this can be turned off in Features -> Manage Defaults.
defaultChoiceText: This is a Choice, and inside of it, you can place images and text. Scores can be added to it, and have Point-types attached. Addons can be added underneath the image and text. In the Functions at the bottom of the choice, there is an array of different things that can be done. Default text like this can be turned off in Features then Manage Defaults.
